metadata.purpose: Witnesses G2+FG2 without FP-synt. G2+FG2 consistent with no primitive fixed point.
metadata.note: Period-2 orbit of T gives alternating nFG2 pattern. FG2 holds because T<=c.
metadata.long_description: G2=T FG2=T FP=F. Both G2 and FG2 hold without any syntactic FP. The preorder has T<c, bot isolated. boxtimes(T)=c, boxtimes(c)=T, boxtimes(bot)=T. G2 holds vacuously (boxtimes(T)=c not <=bot). FG2: boxtimes^2(T)=boxtimes(c)=T<=c=boxtimes(T) since T<c. No syntactic FP: boxtimes(T)=c!=T, boxtimes(c)=T!=c, boxtimes(bot)=T!=bot. nFG2 oscillates T,F,T,F (period-2 orbit).
